title.zh: 将拉乌尼翁省 Naguilian 市镇 Naguilian 区医院床位由二十五（25）张增至五十（50）张并为其拨款
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Naguilian District Hospital in the Municipality of Naguilian, Province of La Union From Twenty-Five (25) Beds to Fifty (50) Beds and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Naguilian District Hospital in the Municipality of Naguilian, Province of La Union From Twenty-Five (25) Beds to Fifty (50) Beds and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tăng sức chứa giường bệnh của Bệnh viện Huyện Naguilian tại Đô thị Naguilian, Tỉnh La Union từ 25 lên 50 giường, và phân bổ kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเพิ่มจำนวนเตียงของโรงพยาบาลอำเภอ Naguilian ในเทศบาล Naguilian จังหวัด La Union จาก 25 เป็น 50 เตียง และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang meningkatkan kapasitas tempat tidur Rumah Sakit Distrik Naguilian di Kotamadya Naguilian, Provinsi La Union dari 25 menjadi 50 tempat tidur, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta meningkatkan kapasiti katil Hospital Daerah Naguilian di Perbandaran Naguilian, Wilayah La Union daripada 25 kepada 50 katil, serta memperuntukkan dana

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2021/ra_11559_2021.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The authorized bed capacity of the Naguilian District Hospital in the Municipality of Naguilian, Province of La Union is hereby increased from twenty-five (25) beds to fifty (50) beds. Any future increase in bed capacity shall be consistent with the hospital development plan.

The existing professional health care services and facilities of the Naguilian District Hospital are also hereby upgraded to conform with and be commensurate to the increase in bed capacity as provided for in Section 1 hereof.

The Provincial Government of La Union shall provide the necessary funds to support the increase in bed capacity of the Naguilian District Hospital and the corresponding upgrading of its facilities and services.

The amount of Two hundred million pesos (P200,000,000.00) is hereby appropriated for the implementation of this Act shall be included and funded under the 2022 General Appropriations Act under the Health Facilities Enhancement Program (HFEP) of the Department of Health.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
